exhaustive_scope: All literal Backend registrations and write_-named registrations in Yosys core source at both pinned commits (backends, frontends, passes, techlibs, kernel), checked against CMake backend directories; all 22 production write_* backends and test_autotb. File-writer candidates and registered-command help were scanned for auxiliary formats. Plugins, external executables and source submodules can define additional unbounded output formats.
build_scope: Source inventory of upstream's available components, not a claim that every distributor or selectively configured YOSYS_COMPONENTS binary enables them. No latest-version build or arbitrary-input export suite was run.

verification.method: Official GitHub release/commit/tree metadata via connector; official pinned codeload archives; every core C++ source blob independently hashed against GitHub tree entries

production_backends.semantics: Serializes Yosys internal design objects, including processes, memories, cells, hierarchy, attributes and X/Z constants; consumers still need RTLIL cell semantics.
production_backends.constraints: No requirement to lower processes or memories. Main has Twine identity/replayable printing changes since v0.70; pin version and dialect.

production_backends.semantics: Hierarchy, cells, parameters, attributes, ports, memories and bit connections; optional AIG models for supported cell types.
production_backends.constraints: Processes are explicitly rejected: run proc. A syntactically present cell instance is not a definition of that cell's behavior. Memory/cell semantics need an interpreter.

production_backends.semantics: Netlist with expressions/always blocks for recognized internal cells and instances for external cells; hierarchy and memories can be emitted.
production_backends.constraints: Help requires proc: RTLIL processes cannot always be mapped directly and trigger a warning. Unmapped/library instances still require external definitions. -sv emits constructs such as always_comb, not a distinct backend.

production_backends.semantics: Boolean logic and latches where recognized; other cell/module instances use .subckt or .gate references.
production_backends.constraints: Unmapped RTLIL processes and memories are rejected. -conn/-attr/-param/-cname and related extensions are nonstandard; help advises another suffix for custom consumers.

production_backends.semantics: Structural cell and wire connectivity in the Xilinx place and route EDIF flavor.
production_backends.constraints: Unmapped processes/memories rejected; cells require matching library definitions. X bits may be exported as zero with a warning. Other EDIF consumers may need adaptation.

production_backends.semantics: Structural instances/subcircuits and connectivity, including chosen power/ground names.
production_backends.constraints: Unmapped processes/memories rejected. Cell/subcircuit models are external; missing blackbox declarations cause guessed port order. Does not synthesize transistor models for arbitrary RTLIL cells.

production_backends.semantics: Recognized coarse cells, modules and blackbox extmodules translated into FIRRTL.
production_backends.constraints: Subset only: rejects inout module ports, unsupported cells, negative-edge FFs, initialized memories, nonzero memory offsets, clocked reads, asynchronous/negedge writes and complex write enables. Warns unsupported register initial values. Automatically runs pmuxtree/bmuxmap/demuxmap/bwmuxmap.

production_backends.semantics: Cell types, connection types and word-wide netlists for coarse-grain example-driven interconnect synthesis.
production_backends.constraints: Rejects unprocessed memories/processes, unknown cell types, composite signals and signals that are not word-wide. Cell interfaces must be known; -lib adds Verilog/RTLIL library definitions.

production_backends.semantics: Flattened AND/inverter graph with simple FF state; asserts become bad-state properties and assumes invariant constraints. Initstate/nondeterministic formal cells have special handling.
production_backends.constraints: Requires flattened and gate-lowered design; no unprocessed memories/processes. Supported FFs include $_FF_ and $_DFF_[NP]_; arbitrary clocks/resets/enables must be normalized before interpreting an AIGER transition as a clocked hardware step. Unsupported cell kinds error. -ywmap currently requires -zinit.

production_backends.semantics: Experimental newer writer directly ingests a larger supported subset of combinational coarse cells/gates and can traverse hierarchy with -flatten.
production_backends.constraints: Not a drop-in sequential replacement for write_aiger: known_ops is combinational, no FF/memory operations. Unknown/blackbox cells fail; -flatten respects keep_hierarchy. Source has TODOs for inout, undriven and zero-width cases. Help generates its unsupported-cell list dynamically; literal extraction retains %s and raw C++.

production_backends.semantics: AIG plus ABC box information and optional simple FFs; non-AIG/non-box cells become pseudo-inputs and pseudo-outputs. Whiteboxes can use $abc9_holes definitions.
production_backends.constraints: A cut-and-box mapping representation; not automatically a complete standalone semantic model. -dff enables $_DFF_[NP]_. Symbol map references are valid only in the writing Yosys run unless debug string maps are selected.

production_backends.semantics: Newer combinational AIG writer with hierarchical/opaque-box information for ABC.
production_backends.constraints: Same combinational known_ops core as aiger2, with boxed unsupported logic rather than a general clocked model. -mapping_prep mutates/removes exported cells; -mapping_prep and -map2 conflict with -flatten.

production_backends.semantics: Per-module state sort, hierarchy relation, initial predicate, transition relation and assertion/assumption/cover predicates; BitVec arithmetic and ArraysEx memories by default.
production_backends.constraints: Lower processes. Unmap sync reset/enables with dffunmap; async FFs need async2sync; dffunmap or clk2fflogic, and latches need clk2fflogic. Read-port registers must not be merged into memories (memory -nordff / memory_nordff). -nobv implies -nomem, -stbv disables array memories. Unknown cells fail unless explicitly supplied as SMT blackboxes; $live/$fair/$equiv are rejected. A proof driver must assert hierarchy/init/transition predicates correctly; clock normalization matters for multiple clocks.

production_backends.semantics: Bit-vector/array state, init/next transitions, bad properties and constraints. Despite command/help spelling BTOR, emitted sort/state/next syntax is BTOR2.
production_backends.constraints: One top module; flatten hierarchy/resolve unknown cells. Normalize FF types as with SMT2 (dffunmap, async2sync or clk2fflogic); no synchronous memory reads (memory_nordff), no mixed sync/async memory write ports. Explicit error paths for unsupported cells. A hardware proof still requires an agreed clock-step model.

production_backends.semantics: SMV module expressions and next-state equations for a supported subset.
production_backends.constraints: Help says UNDER CONSTRUCTION. Modules with raw memories/processes are skipped with warnings; packed $mem is a FIXME. Supports only selected cell/FF types; error messages require dffunmap, async2sync or clk2fflogic for unsupported FF families. Do not assume arbitrary mapped cells or memory support.

production_backends.semantics: Executable RTL simulation code and optional header, with sequential state, memories, hierarchy, blackbox interfaces and explicit eval/commit stepping.
production_backends.constraints: Requires driver clock/port interaction and race-free scheduling. Supports processes (normally lowers them unless -noproc); rejects unknown cells, unmarked external blackboxes, multi-driver wires and global-clock processes. C++ simulation model is not a Lean proof artifact.
variants: CXXRTL C API and VCD runtime are companion interfaces

production_backends.semantics: Simple C intended for C simulation and C-based verification; separate from CXXRTL and functional C++.
production_backends.constraints: Help says UNDER CONSTRUCTION. Actual eval_cell supports a limited set of fine Boolean gates; unknown cells fail with 'No C model ... FIXME'. Requires a top module. No blanket memory/FF/clock support claim.

production_backends.semantics: Per-selected-module pure evaluation/state functions and initial state using functional C++ runtime; separate from CXXRTL.
production_backends.constraints: Shared Functional IR requires normalized global-clock FFs (FfData.has_gclk), not ordinary clocked FFs; source recommends async2sync or clk2fflogic. Collect memories with memory_collect; write ports must be asynchronous and read ports unclocked (memory_nordff). Memories without read ports are rejected. Undriven/multiply-driven nets, combinational loops, unknown cell kinds and $check are rejected; $check requires chformal -lower. Flatten/resolve hierarchy and lower processes before treating each selected module as a standalone function. X collision values are treated as don't cares. Command help is TODO; use source constraints rather than inferring maturity.

production_backends.semantics: Functional bit-vector/array/state encoding; separate schema from traditional write_smt2 and its SMTBMC metadata contract.
production_backends.constraints: Shared Functional IR requires normalized global-clock FFs (FfData.has_gclk), not ordinary clocked FFs; source recommends async2sync or clk2fflogic. Collect memories with memory_collect; write ports must be asynchronous and read ports unclocked (memory_nordff). Memories without read ports are rejected. Undriven/multiply-driven nets, combinational loops, unknown cell kinds and $check are rejected; $check requires chformal -lower. Flatten/resolve hierarchy and lower processes before treating each selected module as a standalone function. X collision values are treated as don't cares. Help contains only a one-line description.

production_backends.semantics: #lang rosette/safe output with bit-vector operations, memories and state from Functional IR.
production_backends.constraints: Shared Functional IR requires normalized global-clock FFs (FfData.has_gclk), not ordinary clocked FFs; source recommends async2sync or clk2fflogic. Collect memories with memory_collect; write ports must be asynchronous and read ports unclocked (memory_nordff). Memories without read ports are rejected. Undriven/multiply-driven nets, combinational loops, unknown cell kinds and $check are rejected; $check requires chformal -lower. Flatten/resolve hierarchy and lower processes before treating each selected module as a standalone function. X collision values are treated as don't cares.

production_backends.semantics: JSON metadata, module/cell type summaries, selected connections, attributes and parameters according to misc/jny.schema.json.
production_backends.constraints: Metadata interchange, not a replacement for a complete RTLIL/HDL/formal semantics. Help synopsis says jny, but actual Backend registration creates write_jny; jny pass is a selected-object alternative.

production_backends.semantics: Six columns: module, cell, type, port, direction, signal; module IO represented as pseudo cells.
production_backends.constraints: Connectivity view only; it omits the full behavioral definitions/parameters needed to interpret arbitrary cells and processes.

auxiliary_exports.notes: Selected RTLIL dump; -outfile/-append output file.
Selected-object form of write_json, with -o.
Selected-object metadata form, with -o.
Only extracted $fsm cells; -origenc/-o/-noauto; not a whole-design format.
-fm_set_fsm_file / -encfile report old/new FSM state encodings.

formats: Graphviz render target such as SVG or PostScript
auxiliary_exports.notes: Yosys emits DOT; other requested formats are rendered by external dot, whose formats are an external dependency.
Dataflow graph; external dot renders non-DOT output.
-dump_cnf serializes the configured SAT problem; -dump_vcd/-dump_json serialize a found model/counterexample, not the full circuit.
-vcd/-fst/-aiw/-summary; AIW requires symbol map. FST availability depends on the build. Reading WIT/YW is not an output backend.
-tb <name> produces <name>.v and <name>.txt from FST stimuli.
The 23rd Backend registration, outside backends/. Generates primitive semi-random testbenches; samples are produced when generated HDL runs.
Interfaces of used internal cells; help explicitly says models are not guaranteed logically sound. Not a sound complete hardware export.
-write_lut/-write_box dump precomputed mapping libraries. ABC is an external engine; its own arbitrary export commands are not Yosys backends.
-map records generated output property port assignments.
-lcov produces source-location coverage from selection; no circuit semantics.
-json writes to log/console; tee can save it. Distinct from write_json.
help <cell>+ emits the Verilog model. Undocumented internal -dump-cmds-json/-dump-cells-json write documentation schemas, not netlists.
-write emits the same objects as -list.
-list with -o/-s outputs mutation commands and src metadata.
-dump-final-smt2 and -write-solution; underlying yosys-smtbmc/SMT solver external execution is separate.

formats: temporary Tcl script, Verilog netlist and Liberty interfaces
auxiliary_exports.notes: Yosys runs external OpenSTA write_sdc; no registered built-in write_sdc command. Requires OpenSTA and the relevant Yosys components.
Only with proprietary Verific support: -d dumps Verific netlist; -pp pretty-prints loaded Verific designs, including -vhdl if supported. Not a write_vhdl backend from arbitrary RTLIL.
Registered as Frontend(=write_file); copies text, does not translate hardware.
Routes another command's log to a file; does not add a netlist format.
-l/-L, -E/--deps-file, --perffile; not hardware semantics.

formats: already-counted RTLIL or Verilog, plus logs/scripts
auxiliary_exports.notes: bugpoint, extract -mine, freduce -dump, test_cell HDL dumping, read_verilog AST/Verilog/RTLIL debugging, synth_* output-file switches and ABC temporary artifacts reuse formats. Arbitrary logs, AST debug text, scripts and library/compiler traces are not additional whole-design backends.
--dump-vcd/--dump-yw/--dump-vlogtb/--dump-smtc; SMTIO --dump-smt2. These are proof traces/problems, not additional registered Yosys design backends.
yw2yw, aiw2yw, yw2aiw, wit2yw convert/transform witnesses using backend map files. Reading BTOR witnesses does not imply writing a BTOR witness format.

limitations: Finite source census, not every arbitrary file emitted by plugins, the shell/Tcl/Python APIs, ABC, Graphviz, OpenSTA or linked proprietary libraries.

Auxiliary output survey includes explicit file options, reports, mapping sidecars, visualizations, solver traces and bundled witness tools; log text/debug AST dumps are not each counted as distinct whole-design interchange languages.

Full raw C++ help bodies and literal help strings are retained in source-registry-*.json. Dynamic help expansion (notably aiger2 supported-cell exclusions) was inspected in source, not executed; %s placeholders are not actual runtime command output.
Model generation is not by itself a proof of the exporter or a Lean-checked equivalence certificate; input domain, cell library, X/Z treatment, clock model and preprocessing must be fixed separately.
